entities.name: Query adenylosuccinate synthetase
observations: 449 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 49.35 kDa and theoretical pI 5.64.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q2JQ36; 100% identity and full-length coverage.
Pfam Adenylsucc_synt (PF00709.28) spans residues 5–421 with i-Evalue 2.1e-185.
Curated homologs annotate cytosolic homodimeric adenylosuccinate synthetase, EC 6.3.4.4.
Curated homologs report one Mg2+ ion bound per subunit and GTP binding.

entities.name: Adenylosuccinate synthesis
observations: IMP + L-aspartate + GTP → adenylosuccinate [N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)-AMP] + GDP + phosphate + 2 H+.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:15753 and catalyzed by EC 6.3.4.4 adenylosuccinate synthetase.
This is the first committed step of de novo AMP biosynthesis from IMP.

entities.name: De novo AMP biosynthesis
observations: Adenylosuccinate synthetase catalyzes the IMP-to-adenylosuccinate step in purine metabolism before adenylosuccinate lyase produces AMP.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations state that adenylosuccinate synthetase binds one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ supports nucleotide-substrate chemistry.
